steps: 1. Data skills v7 (36 nodes), balance v53, working tree. 2. From the repo root: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> reg_bio decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=bio (seeds 1, 3, 4). 3. Read the RESULT line: win_cycle. Control: same command with --skip-skill=BIO_5B (tag nat_BIO_5B), which gives win 30, 31, 27.
expected: Decent bio focus wins between cycles 27 and 30 (the decent band).
actual: Wins at cycles 40 (seed 1), 38 (seed 3) and 40 (seed 4). Seed 2 wins at 27. With BIO_5B removed the same seeds win at 30, 31 and 27. The regression comes from BIO_5B.

steps: 1. As above, bio focus with and without BIO_5B (reg_bio vs nat_BIO_5B), seeds 1 to 4, keep-running 38. 2. Compare final_cash and final_shares_by_market.bio.
expected: BIO_5B (bio route capacity +12.5 pct) adds cash or share, as the round 2 KEEP verdict assumed.
actual: With BIO_5B, final cash is lower in 4 of 4 seeds (-15.7k, -2.7k, -14.5k, -31.9k) and bio share is lower in 3 of 4 seeds (-0.098, +0.088, -0.094, -0.151). Route capacity change is -14, +10, -9 and -19 pct, but route sets differ between arms, so that reading is confounded. Verdict for the owner: CHANGE; drop it if the node cannot be retuned.

steps: 1. Whitelist arm, same seed on and off: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> brb_bio_5B decent 4 --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=bio --skills=FND_STORAGE,FND_PERMIT,FND_PROSPECT,BIO_1,BIO_3,BIO_5,BIO_5B. 2. Control brb_bio_base: same flags without BIO_5B.
expected: A decent bio focus wins at cycle 27 with or without BIO_5B (the base arm does: win 27, cash 38939, share 0.728).
actual: With BIO_5B: no win by cycle 40, final cash 492, bio share 0.235 (outcome soft). Seeds 1 to 3 win at 27 in both arms. BIO_5B alone turns seed 4 from a win into a collapse.

steps: 1. qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> reg_lux decent 3 --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=lux. 2. Read outcome, win_cycle, final_cash, final_shares_by_market.lux. Control: nat_LUX_5B decent 3 (same flags plus --skip-skill=LUX_5B).
expected: A decent lux focus player wins at 27 to 30 (round 2 result for this seed: win 27).
actual: No win by cycle 40 (END_OUTCOMPETED). Final cash 1197, lux share 0.336. Without LUX_5B the same seed wins at 27 (cash 12207, share 0.500). Branch arm brb_lux_5B seed 3 also has no win, so the cause is the path that LUX_5B changes, not the event sequence (that is identical, see the report, section 2).

steps: 1. qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> reg_lux decent 2 --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=lux. 2. Read win_cycle (first win, kept run).
expected: Decent lux focus wins at cycle 27 to 30.
actual: First win at cycle 33; the kept run then ends END_OUTCOMPETED at 40. Without LUX_5B the same seed does not win by 40 (nat_LUX_5B seed 2: no win, cash 8716). Pacing flag on the with-node arm only.

steps: 1. Natural: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> reg_bio decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=bio, and check skills_owned for BIO_6B. 2. Whitelist: brb_bio_6B vs brb_bio_base (same flags, --skills=FND_STORAGE,FND_PERMIT,FND_PROSPECT,BIO_1,BIO_3,BIO_5 with and without BIO_6B). 3. Compare final_shares_by_market.bio.
expected: BIO_6B (shared chosen-bot hit, now 0.35) is learned in the bio focus and moves bio share by at least 0.02.
actual: Natural: learned in 1 of 4 seeds (seed 1). Whitelisted: learned in 4 of 4, 3 to 4 successful hits per run, bio share +0.007, +0.010, +0.007, +0.008 (below 0.02 in 4 of 4). Raising the hit from 0.25 to 0.35 moved share by about 0.003. Cash identical with and without in all 4 seeds (see the open question in the report). Verdict: DROP.

steps: 1. qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> reg_min decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=min (control nat_MIN_5B with --skip-skill=MIN_5B). 2. Whitelist: brb_min_5B vs brb_min_base. 3. Compare win_cycle, final_cash, route_units_by_market.min. 4. Count EV17 (debris) starts in event_rows.
expected: MIN_5B (+10 pct Minerals route capacity, debris immunity, min price-down cut 0.3) moves the min focus win, share or cash.
actual: Route capacity is +10 pct exactly in every seed (2464 vs 2240 units). Win is 27 in every arm and share is unchanged. Cash moves +0.4k to +1.6k in 3 seeds and -5.9k in one (natural arm). Debris (EV17) started 0 times in 92 runs, so the debris half is UNTESTABLE. Verdict: CHANGE (capacity is real; the min focus is at the cycle-27 floor, so it cannot show a win effect).

steps: 1. Natural: reg_lux vs nat_LUX_6B (--skip-skill=LUX_6B), decent, --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=lux. 2. Whitelist: brb_lux_5B vs brb_lux_5B_6B. 3. Compare win_cycle, final_cash, route_units_by_market.lux.
expected: LUX_6B (lux price-down cut 0.3, +10 pct lux route capacity) gives a consistent gain in win cycle or cash.
actual: Whitelist: route capacity +22, +15, +34 and -28 pct; win earlier or later by at most 8 cycles, sign not consistent (seed 4: 27 without, 35 with; seed 3: no win without, 31 with); cash between -21.0k and +2.8k. Natural: wins 27/27, 33/39, none/none, 29/27. Verdict: CHANGE (no consistent direction).

expected: Whitelisted MIL_5 plus BIO_6B wins at cycle 27 (round 2 result for this arm: win 27 with FND_BULK auto-allowed).
actual: No win by cycle 40. Lock timing is correct in this run (hits every 6 cycles, own cooldowns held). Test-only whitelist, so low severity. Affects the lock arm only, not the natural decent path.

steps: 1. qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> brb_bio_6B decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=bio --skills=FND_STORAGE,FND_PERMIT,FND_PROSPECT,BIO_1,BIO_3,BIO_5,BIO_6B and brb_bio_base (without BIO_6B). 2. Compare final_cash and final_shares_by_market.bio.
expected: A share change from a chosen-bot hit is either reflected in cash or the cash-share relation is documented (UNKNOWN which).
actual: bio share differs by +0.007 to +0.010 with BIO_6B, but final cash is identical to the unit in all 4 seeds (25385, 34741, 24110, 38939). Need a check that final share does not feed cash in this path, or that the cash path is intended.
